issues.on_page: Local 8,835,831 (Total Governmental Funds); p2: Property and other taxes 6,657,697, charges for services 1,669,793
issues.issue: Correctly restored as the printed line (label, amount and page match, with no split). But the broad 'Local' group is not all taxes: the p2 general receipts show Property and other taxes 6,657,697, about 75% of it, and the rest is mostly charges for services. taxes (unlabeled) is a defensible dominant-category choice, but the line is mixed.

issues.on_page: INHERITANCE TAX FUND RECEIPTS: Local 603,360 (budget 75,000); p4 Inheritance Tax Fund column Local 603,360; full PDF note 1B (report p11): 'Inheritance Tax Fund - ... receipts and disbursements for inheritance tax collected'
issues.issue: Fix is consistent: label 'Local', amount 603,360 and budget 75,000 match p8, and taxes (unlabeled) matches receipts[0] 'Local' and the other funds' 'Local' detail lines (General, Road and Bridge, Nonmajor). Nothing printed shows a non-tax part (no interest or fee line for this fund; it is the fund's only receipt line), so the evidence points to a tax line, not mixed local receipts. The only thing naming it inheritance tax is the fund's own description in note 1B, which under the rule (fund names/descriptions are not evidence) doesn't prove the type; no printed inheritance-tax amount exists (p2 shows only 'Property and other taxes 6,657,697'). If the user accepts the fund description as evidence, 'inheritance tax' would be the category.
